g.text: From signing in to replying to an offer. Applying early gives no advantage: submission time is not a lottery input.
ticket and sends a link request
together only: all siblings in one week, or none
together preferred: try together, then one by one
independent: each child on their own
Odds are a band (Likely, About even), never a precise percentage, and the page
says plainly: ranking honestly never hurts you.
